payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about features extracted from text, particularly in the context of Named Entity Recognition (NER) and information extraction techniques.

claims.text: Features extracted from text include keywords representing names and surnames, which are used in Named Entity Recognition (NER) systems.
The approach combines text features with image features to improve the classification of named entities.
The architecture proposed does not rely on hand-crafted features but instead uses features extracted from unstructured data sources, including text.
